findings.why: The product page gives 2% as the combined strength of BHA + LHA (Salicylic Acid + Capryloyl Salicylic Acid), but this line reads as 2% salicylic acid with LHA added on top, overstating the salicylic acid strength in the on-image text most viewers read. The pack name on the same card ('Salicylic Acid + LHA 2% Cleanser') puts the 2% after the pair.
findings.fix: Salicylic Acid + LHA 2% (the pack's order, so the 2% covers both acids)

findings.why: Same placement problem in the headline: '2% BHA + LHA' reads as 2% BHA (salicylic acid) plus LHA, while the product page and the ad's own primary text ('BHA + LHA in 2% concentration') make 2% the combined strength of both acids.
findings.fix: BHA + LHA 2% (headline: 'Spotted: oiliness. Meet BHA + LHA 2%')

findings.why: Paired with the headline 'Spotted: oiliness.', this can read as a promise that skin will have nothing left to hide after using the cleanser, an implied absolute result much like 'no more oily skin'. It is fine only if the reviewer is satisfied it reads as Minimalist's transparency sign-off about the formula, not a skin outcome.
findings.fix: Remove it and let 'Skin Science' and the product name close the card; keep it only if the reviewer confirms it reads as a transparency line rather than a promise about the skin.

tone_read: Largely on-voice: calm and educational, it names both actives, the 2% strength and what each acid does, with no hype words, emoji, exclamation marks or urgency, and 'Spotted: oiliness.' and 'Back from a run?' are light, situational hooks rather than fear or shame framing. The one off note is the 'Hide Nothing.' sign-off, which suits the brand's transparency stance beside 'Skin Science' but, read against 'Spotted: oiliness.', drifts into a promise about the skin.
language_read: Active naming and hedging follow the brand: 'Salicylic Acid (BHA) helps reduce the oily look' is scoped to appearance, 'LHA gives gentle exfoliation on the outer layer' is a mechanism line taken from the product page, 'BHA + LHA in 2% concentration' states the strength exactly, and there is no natural or chemical-free framing. The slip is where the 2% sits: '2% Salicylic Acid + LHA' and '2% BHA + LHA' attach it to salicylic acid alone, whereas the pack name 'Salicylic Acid + LHA 2% Cleanser' and the page make it the combined strength of the two acids.
